## Context (discovered during RP-05 S2d)
The py3.13 help-rendering divergences RP-05 S2d fixed — argparse (1) rendering an option with BOTH short+long forms as `-o, --output X` (metavar once) vs pre-3.13 `-o X, --output X`, and (2) keeping a subparsers `{choices} ...` usage line unwrapped where pre-3.13 wrapped the `...` — are pinned to pre-3.13 output ONLY inside `RebarHelpFormatter` (src/rebar/_cli/_parser.py: the `_format_action_invocation` and `_format_usage` overrides).

Of the advanced parser factories, only `bridge` was switched to `RebarHelpFormatter`. Every other advanced parser — metrics, config, audit, llm_eval, enrich, certs (src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/) — still passes `formatter_class=argparse.HelpFormatter`. Today their help bytes are byte-identical across py3.11/3.12/3.13.15 because none of them currently has an option with both short+long forms carrying a metavar, nor a subparsers usage line that wraps.

## Risk
A FUTURE change to any stock-formatter advanced parser that adds a short+long metavar option, or whose subparsers usage line grows past the width, would render differently on py3.13 than on 3.11/3.12 — silently making `scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check` (and the docs reference `--check`) go STALE on the py3.13 CI cell only, exactly the failure mode S2d spent multiple patchsets chasing.

## Proposed fix
Switch the remaining advanced parser factories from `argparse.HelpFormatter` to `RebarHelpFormatter` (verified byte-identical on py3.12 for bridge), OR add a targeted contract test that fails if any registered parser factory uses a non-version-pinned formatter. Prefer the former (removes the latent trap at the source).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every advanced (and core) parser factory renders help via a version-pinned formatter, OR a contract test fails when a factory uses a non-pinned formatter.
- [ ] `gen_cli_help.py --check` and `gen_cli_reference.py --check` proven byte-identical across py3.11/3.12/3.13.15.
- [ ] No change to any committed help artifact bytes (behavior-preserving for current parsers).
